title: Customer support privacy evidence readiness review

sources.text: Processing register excerpt: support team uses name, email address and ticket history to resolve service requests; system owner is Customer Operations.
Privacy notice draft: data is used to respond to service enquiries and is retained for 24 months after ticket closure.
Supplier list: Helpdesk Cloud Ltd hosts ticket records; a current operator agreement and subprocessor schedule were not attached.
Operations note: staff can search tickets by email; no documented request verification, response deadline or deletion evidence was supplied.
Incident procedure draft: privacy concerns are escalated to the service manager; breach assessment criteria, regulator notification workflow and test record were not supplied.
